fee_notes: Single-unit fee is $49,500 nonrefundable. Veterans receive $4,950 discount (51%+ ownership, honorably discharged, Form DD-214, first franchise only). Area developers pay a development fee equal to sum of all initial franchise fees: 2 salons=$89,500, 3=$124,500, 4=$154,500 (+$30,000 per additional salon). Per-salon fee reduces to $40,000 (2), $35,000 (3), $30,000 (4+) under ADA. Opening Inventory Package ($120,100-$130,250) also required with $30,000 deposit at signing.
raw_excerpt: You pay us a nonrefundable $49,500 initial franchise fee when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
